title: The project report's words as an AI draft
status: Set by Claude at the owner's request (REP2, D-AI-01, D-AI-02): an AI drafts six short sections from the user's own inputs, in simple words; this file's checks drop any sentence that holds a figure the user did not type, or a claim a new business cannot have. Nothing goes in the document until the borrower ticks that the words are true.
source: D-AI-01 (the owner's answer 3 in REP1, 20-10-2026) and Finline's report as the owner met it, finding 6 (docs/design-inputs/finline-2026-10-20.md): a business not yet started called reputable and well-established, with a strong market presence, a loyal customer base and CSR work with NGOs.

sections.label: Introduction
sections.from: who runs the business, what it will do and where, its constitution, and the scheme it applies under

sections.label: The products
sections.from: what the business will sell, from the products named and what it does

sections.label: The process
sections.from: how the products are made or the service given, from the user's note on the process only

sections.label: The market
sections.from: who will buy and where, from the user's note on the market only

sections.label: The promoter
sections.from: the promoter's education and work so far, from the user's note on the promoter only

sections.label: Conclusion
sections.from: what the project sets out to do, and that the report's tables set out its cost, its finance and how the loan is repaid; never whether it is viable

notes.label: The promoter
notes.hint: Name, education and work so far, in your words. Like “Asha Rao, B.Com; eight years in a packaging firm’s stores”.

notes.label: How it is made or done
notes.hint: The steps, the machines, where the materials come from.

notes.label: Who will buy, and where
notes.hint: The buyers and the places; any orders or talks already.

figures.why: a figure: the report's tables carry every figure

claims.why: customers it does not have yet

claims.pattern: \bmarket presence\b|\bpresence in the market\b|\bstrong presence\b|\bmarket share\b

claims.why: a record it does not have yet
